To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the cholinergic neurons of the basal forebrain originate in the ventral pallial domain and migrate from this region to the medial ganglione eminence.

the basal forebrain choline acetyltransferase-positive neurons of the basal forebrain that project to the cerebral cortex originate in the ventral pallial Tbr1-expressed cells and migrate to the basal forebrain through the basal telencephalon.
basal forebrain cholinegic neurons originate in the ventral pallial region, migrate from the ventral gallium to the sub-pallium and that Fgf8 is a key signaling molecule in this migratory route.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the origin of basal fore brain cholinergic neurons and the mechanisms controlling their migration and differentiation.
the origin and development of cholinergic basal forebrain neurons that are implicated in neuropsychiatric disorders.
the origin and development of the cortical choline-ergic innervation.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the basal forebrain choline acetyltransferase (ChAT) positive cells originate in the ventral pallial Tbr1 expressing cells that migrate tangentially towards the basal fore brain.

the majority of basal forebrain neurons projecting to cortex are generated in the ventropallial region and that FGF8 signaling in the midline is necessary to attract these neurons to the basal forebrain.
the basal forebrain cholinegic neurons originate in the pallium and that they migrate to the subpalliual area in response to FGF8 signaling.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the basal forebrain cholinegic system originates in the ventral pallial domain of the ventral telencephalon.
the basal forebrain cholineergic neurons originate in the ventral pallial region and migrate tangentially towards the basal fore brain.
the majority of cholinergic basal forebrain neurons originate in the ventral pallial domain and migrate to the basal forebrain in a tangential fashion.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the basal forebrain cholinegic system originates in the telencepahlic pallium and not in the subpallial ventral ganglionic eminences as previously thought.
the basal forebrain cholinegic nuclei originate in the ventropallial domain, which is the same origin of the striatum and the olfactory bulb.
the cholinergic neurons of Meynert nucleus and horizontal limb of diagonal band nucleus originate in the telencepahlic pallium.
